results.title: The Death of Jim McGraw
results.overview: A prosecutor fights for justice in the wake of a billionaire's murder on New Year's Eve.

results.title: Fireweed Blooming
results.overview: In a small village far far away lives Ene. Her days pass by cleaning up after her husband and fishing at the pond. On one such day she sees that a local nymph is being abused by her partner. By saving her Ene reflects on her own life.

results.title: Hunger
results.overview: When a baby cries, it must be fed. A good mother would not let the child starve to death. A good father would not want to kill it.

results.title: Ghost Board
results.overview: A woman sees a mysterious man and seeks answers in a Ouija board.

results.title: Everything As It Should Be
results.overview: Monika has the life she always dreamed of: she’s a successful doctor and expecting a child in a happy relationship with Lukáš. But is she truly happy? When she unexpectedly reunites with her ex-husband Petr after years, her doubts deepen. A brief meeting turns into a long walk through a summer city, during which unanswered questions begin to surface: "Why did we actually break up back then?" and "What if we had made a different choice?" Through dialogue and gentle humor, we observe how a subtle closeness re-emerges between them in quiet moments - whether in the rain, on a tram, or in the park. Director Bohdan Karásek crafts a sensitive, intimate drama about the roads not taken.

results.title: Ash Wednesday
results.overview: The last day of Carnival—Ash Wednesday. February 1976. Saint-Esprit, Martinique.  After living in mainland France for several years under the BUMIDOM program, Liéna returns to her family, sitting numb with grief in the back of the hearse bringing home the body of her younger sister, who had died in the mainland. Arriving at the family home makes the reunion painful. The period of mourning will bring a sorrowful realization...

results.title: Dead End
results.overview: Years after being caught in a game-fixing scandal, former professional baseball player Lin Shengyi returns to his hometown one night, only to discover that his father's impending death has become part of a "death betting scheme", operated under The Elders Mutual-Aid Association. With the help of his former lover and his younger brother, Shengyi makes a desperate decision — to save his father and flee through the night, determined to escape the town before sunrise.

results.title: The House on Lidderman Street
results.overview: A young builder discovers a supernatural entity in the house he is renovating and uses the demonic spirit to exact revenge on the people who have wronged him.

results.title: Dov’è la fiesta?
results.overview: Leo and Irene have been dating for three months, ever since they fell in love at first sight on the beltway. But they haven’t yet faced that moment—the one when you ask yourself, “What are we to each other?” Just on the evening when they finally meet to talk about it, his new car is stolen right outside her house. The party’s over. The theft will plunge them into a frantic, crazy week filled with police stations, insurance companies, DMV offices, roommates, security guards, thieves, fathers, and nuns. The week they lost a car but—perhaps—found love.

results.title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
results.overview: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

results.title: unti-unti
results.overview: Using a camcorder, a young child tries to get her busy parents' attention, hoping to reunite them for another family dinner.

results.title: The Widower
results.overview: Mirsad is a 62-year-old electrician who was raised and lives in a patriarchal society. His daily routine changes after the sudden death of his wife Enisa. Mirsad stays alone while his grown children live their own lives. As Mirsad tries to get used to a life without his wife, he realizes that he took her for granted and had not given her the love and care she deserved. Mirsad's relationship with his estranged son worsens after he discovers that the son lives with a male friend.

results.title: Madam
results.overview: An unlucky man becomes a pawn in a mischievous ghoul's deadly game.

results.title: Obsession
results.overview: After his onstage fall, the father continues to focus on rehearsals and raises his daughter through discipline and paternal love. At the community center, he pushes the girl through the same routine over and over until she's exhausted: she breaks down, cries, and runs away, but the father finds his gentle side, brings her back to her work, and provides support.

results.title: Don't F with Mary Jane
results.overview: After discovering her boyfriend is cheating, an emotionally unstable Mary Jane goes on a violent spree to "test" whether the men from her past have changed-spiraling into a dark, comedic nightmare of love, revenge, and delusion.

results.title: Misfortune in Life, of a man who suffers in silence
results.original_title: Olyckor i Tillvaron, för en man som lider tyst
results.overview: In a vast empty parking garage that seems to stretch without end, Lennart, an aging bank employee, discovers that he can no longer find his car.  What begins as a minor inconvenience slowly transforms into an absurd journey through identical floors, quiet reflections and strange encounters. As he searches the concrete maze, reality starts to bend around him. A mysterious figure appears and disappears, offering riddles instead of answers, while the outside world waits for his return.  Trapped in a cycle of repetition and frustration, Lennart is forced to confront a growing sense of hopelessness. As the search continues, the missing car becomes more than a lost vehicle. It becomes a reflection of a man struggling to regain his control in a world that seems to move forward without him.  Misfortune in Life, for a Man Who Suffers in Silence is an absurdist drama about hopelessness, loss of control, and the quiet fear of being left behind.

results.title: INDIGO
results.overview: Can love only come from others? Or can one find that to love, and to be loved, can come from the same person…
